findings.title: Tanh-sinh quadrature tail check in xc_integrate truncates integrals with mass away from the midpoint
findings.impact_level: III (niche: lda_x_1d_soft for beta*kF >~ 38.6)
findings.status: Resolved upstream

findings.title: Noisy v_sigma of HSE-family exchange at small reduced gradient
findings.impact_level: II
findings.status: Already fixed in devel by the developers

findings.title: Four-centre ERIs lose precision at high angular momentum (Rys roots)
findings.impact_level: IV (Delta E_HF = 1e-13 Eh with cc-pV6Z)
findings.status: Documented; not reported

findings.title: ECP-centre derivative kernels return uninitialized memory when the rinv atom has no ECP
findings.impact_level: III (zero inside PySCF; garbage up to 1e256 for direct API users)
findings.status: Reported

findings.title: EEQ Ewald sums with a fixed +-2 image range: charges depend on the equivalent unit cell
findings.impact_level: I for non-reduced cells of compact ionic solids (MgO: 34 % in E_D4, dq = 0.6); III-IV for standard cells (<= 0.05 kJ/mol/f.u.)
findings.status: Known issue; data contributed

findings.title: HSE03/06/12, LC-wPBE and wPBEh energy is discontinuous at s = 1 (s_scaling_2)
findings.impact_level: II
findings.status: Classified; not to be reported (deliberate fidelity to HSE06)

findings.title: Derivative of TPSS/TM-family correlation at tau = tau_W (z = 1) depends on rounding
findings.impact_level: IV
findings.status: Documented; not reported

findings.title: Out-of-bounds read of TURNOVER_POINT[40] for Boys order m >= 40 corrupts SR integrals at high l
findings.impact_level: III (SR integrals with l >~ 10; errors up to 3e8, build-dependent)
findings.status: Reported (verified independently, attributed, minimal fix verified)

findings.title: xc_E1_scaled_jet switches to the asymptotic series at z = 18, where it is still inaccurate
findings.impact_level: II (to be measured in molecules)
findings.status: Verified; attribution of the LC-wPBE inconsistency pending

findings.title: pc07_thr = 1/40 inherited by PC07-opt (SCAN-L, r2SCAN-L): a 4.6e-5 indicator value is truncated to zero
findings.impact_level: II (zk jump ~1.8e-6 relative per point; molecular impact not measured)
findings.status: Verified analytically

findings.title: xc_func_set_fhc_enforcement does not propagate to auxiliary functionals of mixed meta-GGAs
findings.impact_level: III (codes that disable FHC, e.g. PAW, with hybrid/mixed meta-GGAs)
findings.status: Verified

findings.title: REVTPSSX registered without XC_KINETIC and with two formula errors
findings.impact_level: III (fails loudly: NaN as registered)
findings.status: Confirmed (level 3): minimal fix matches the publication and libxc to 1e-15

findings.title: REVTPSSC uses z^2 instead of z^3 in eps_c = eps_PKZB (1 + d eps_PKZB z^3)
findings.impact_level: I (silent; atomization energies MAD 0.54, max 1.35 kcal/mol, impact study 2026-11-24)
findings.status: Confirmed (level 3): minimal fix matches the publication and libxc to 4e-11

findings.title: R4SCANX uses d_p4 = d_a4 = 0.232 instead of 0.802 / 0.178
findings.impact_level: I (silent; atomization energies MAD 0.63, max 1.99 kcal/mol, impact study 2026-11-24)
findings.status: Confirmed (level 3): published values 0.802/0.178; minimal fix matches libxc to 3e-14

findings.title: SCANX/SCANC return +-inf at alpha = 1 (uniform gas) and SCANX v_sigma is halved at s = 0
findings.impact_level: III-IV (exact points rarely on molecular grids)
findings.status: Verified

findings.title: TFK (Thomas-Fermi kinetic) ignores spin polarization
findings.impact_level: III (spin-polarized kinetic-energy use, e.g. embedding)
findings.status: Confirmed (level 3): exact spin scaling after minimal fix

findings.title: Segmentation fault for VV10/rVV10 functionals with the XCFun backend
findings.impact_level: III (loud: process killed, exit 139)
findings.status: Reported (verified, attributed, fix tested)

findings.title: lda_c_pk09: NaN and huge values in a band around r_s = 22.739 for spin-polarized densities
findings.impact_level: II-III (open-shell densities near rho ~ 2e-5)
findings.status: Verified (anomaly reproduced); cause: model pole vs implementation pending

findings.title: simple-dftd3 gCP: effective atomic numbers beyond the 35/36-entry parameter tables
findings.impact_level: III (heavy elements: Kr/Xe/Rn with MINIS, Fr/Ra/Ac, Z > 94)
findings.status: Verified (run on released 1.7.0), attributed, fix tested; issue drafted

findings.title: PySCF ECP: table index 400 at z = 16 and crashes of ECPscalar_ipnuc at high angular momentum
findings.impact_level: II-III (A: only z exactly 16; B: nuclear gradients crash with built-in i-function bases and ECPs with a local channel)
findings.status: A verified; B attributed, impact measured, minimal fix verified; extra ASan claims pending

findings.title: dftd4 accepts Z = 112-118 but multicharge EEQ parameters stop at Z = 103: unphysical charges without error
findings.impact_level: III (superheavy elements only)
findings.status: Verified (run), attributed, fix tested; issue drafted

findings.title: libecpint BesselFunction::upper_bound returns a lower bound on the rising side of K_L(z)
findings.impact_level: IV inside libecpint (no caller); III for external users of the public header
findings.status: Verified (code); impact downgraded

findings.title: simple-dftd3 gCP: B_k(x) series vs closed form chosen by abs(za - zb) instead of abs(x)
findings.impact_level: II (gCP derivatives for unlike-element pairs; energy impact not re-measured)
findings.status: Partly verified; included as a minor note in the simple-dftd3 issue

findings.title: libecpint BesselFunction::calculate at z <= 0 writes only K_0; scalar overload returns 1 for all L
findings.impact_level: IV inside libecpint (callers guard x > 0 or rely on zero-initialized buffers); III for external users
findings.status: Verified (code); impact downgraded

findings.title: simple-dftd3 gCP: gradient silently zero unless the virial is also requested
findings.impact_level: III (C API / Fortran callers requesting gradients without sigma)
findings.status: Verified (run), attributed, fix tested; issue drafted

findings.title: multicharge get_charges: intent(out) dqdr left undefined when dqdL is not requested
findings.impact_level: III (callers requesting only Cartesian charge derivatives)
findings.status: Verified (run), attributed, fix tested; issue drafted

findings.title: XCFun TW (von Weizsäcker kinetic energy) squares the squared gradient: T_W of the H atom is 0.0075 Eh instead of 0.5
findings.impact_level: III (wrong by orders of magnitude when used; kinetic functional, used in orbital-free DFT and embedding)
findings.status: Verified (run), attributed, fix tested; needs blind verification by a second agent

findings.title: XCFun SPBEC (sPBE correlation for SSB) has the PBE beta and gamma constants swapped: E_c 63 % too negative
findings.impact_level: I-III (I for anyone computing SSB/sPBE correlation with XCFun; usage to be assessed)
findings.status: Verified (run), attributed, fix tested; needs blind verification and a check against the paper
